final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS sum_of_above_average_totals, AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_averages sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id
